name: Minamino Kirie
source:
Minamino Kirie is Souji's homeroom teacher, and has already been disciplined by him and trained as a sex slave.
On a surface level, she appears cool and strict -- an introverted teacher who is feared by her students due to her harsh teaching policy.
In front of Souji, however, she behaves obediently and faithfully follows all of his orders.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1201256]Getchu[/url]]
